float32_rule: Finite values required; component-gradient/direct-total discrepancies are reported with legacy heuristic pass flag, never asserted to be an exact decomposition.
float64_rule: Deep-copy the same float32 model state; promote each already-built float32 context tensor to float64 without replacing input constants; support is a fresh requires_grad leaf. Independently compute component and total gradients.
validation_scale: sum of weighted component-gradient L2 norms
interpretation: A predeclared validation precision requirement, not a rigorous floating-point roundoff theorem. No tolerance is selected using true closure errors.
old_results_policy: V1 failures and interrupted tasks remain archived; all V2 model fits begin afresh, using only byte-identical shared observation inputs.
